`js-yaml.mjs` is the unmodified ES module distribution of **js-yaml 4.3.2**.
Its MIT license is included in `js-yaml.LICENSE`.

Upstream: https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/tree/4.3.2

The parser is bundled so installing or running the extension does not require
Node.js, npm, Python, a network connection, or a build step.
